# Third-party source policy

The full StickyTags upstream repository is intentionally not committed here because it is large and already has its own Git history.

Use this source reference:

```text
https://github.com/vusec/stickytags.git
commit db3ba2616ce0935fba6352192a43010ba9d3172a
```

If exact local modifications are introduced later, store them as patch files under `patches/`.
